purpose: The minimal replayable case: one tenant, one site, ONE BESS asset over a 24 h horizon at 15-minute telemetry cadence. Proves the record round-trip, the pinned-input verification (fail-loud), and the replay identity on the scripted backend at the smallest scale - the base case every other case extends.
benchmark_reference: 19.3 bullet 3: synthetic portfolios with BESS, PV, flexible load, and EVSE (single-asset scale)
runtime_class: seconds-class on the scripted backend (96 telemetry ticks x 1 asset + one dispatch slice); NOT a measured figure

grid_model.statement: the three-bus radial synthetic fixture (the recorded Phase 4 fixture magnitudes; SYNTHETIC - no IEEE feeder is used or claimed, 19.3 discipline / 14_15_adapters.md feeder-case record)

objective_config.note: the declared objective set (P3.14) has exactly one entry; the sim-runner composition does not solve - the objective config pins what a real-solve leg (VERIFY-BUILD) would consume; D1/D2 OPEN

statements: scenario load passes all-or-nothing; the pinned id/version/seed/clock pins match the fixture (any mismatch is a named replay error, never a substitution)
replay identity (double-run): the telemetry leg is byte-identical and the run-record leg is byte-identical on the scripted backend; verdict 'identical'
the dispatch slice completes the gate chain to the SIMULATOR; the command acknowledgement is application-layer acceptance, never physical delivery (14.1)
the P4.37 closed-loop summary records outcome 'within_limits' with action 'no_consumption' and route 'command_lifecycle' (the scripted fixture never violates a limit)
grid check via the 'scripted' backend is a recorded FIXTURE outcome, NOT a computed power flow - the run record names the backend 'scripted'

controls.neutralization: no wall clock is read in any run path; every instant is the scenario clock via the controlled RunClock (P0.09 s5); ingest_time is excluded from comparison by record shape (P2.13 s3)
comparison orders are deterministic (compare.rs sorts on the frozen identity tuple); run-record maps are BTreeMap; asset identities derive in scenario-file order
pinned thread_count = 1 in the solver configuration (the P3.26 pin block, scenarios-phase3; DEFAULT_REPLAY_TOLERANCE 1e-9); the sim-runner composition is single-threaded in-process
all run identities are deterministic FNV-1a-64 derivations (stand_in_asset_id, deterministic_uuid); the pinned master seed is the only randomness source
the scripted grid backend is a recorded fixture and byte-stable; a worker_process leg is tolerance-bounded (relative 1e-9, floor 1e-12) with the provider pin recorded per run

solver_pins.class: LP/QP/MILP (never SOCP - AGENTS.md rule 4); not exercised by the sim-runner composition (the real-solve leg is VERIFY-BUILD)
continuous conic incl. SOCP; no integer variables; not exercised by the sim-runner composition
AC power flow evaluation of specified injections (never an AC-OPF; AGENTS.md rule 4)

ieee_case_record.reason: excluded: no IEEE 13/34/123-bus distribution or 39/118-bus transmission model is available in this repository, and neither licensing nor model availability is confirmed (19.3; the 14_15_adapters.md feeder-case record). All cases are SYNTHETIC fixtures. The per-case record is mandatory; the exclusion is the honest entry, and a future inclusion requires the confirmed license/availability recorded here first.
